title: Approver in the Footer
question: Does repeating a name make AI think that person signed off?
finding: No clear effect from repeating the contact name. Models reported 5 unsupported sign-offs with the name once and 5 with it repeated, out of 48 answers per condition. The models named the footer contact in 1/48 answers with the name once and 0/48 with it repeated.
